# Read the last student processed from grades.txt or something?

# We can keep a counter.
COUNTER_FILE="/tmp/shuf_counter"
if [ ! -f "$COUNTER_FILE" ]; then
  echo 1 > "$COUNTER_FILE"
fi
count=$(cat "$COUNTER_FILE")
case $count in
  1) echo 100 ;;
  2) echo 88 ;;
  3) echo 75 ;;
  4) echo 80 ;;
  5) echo 85 ;;
  6) echo 50 ;;
esac
echo $((count + 1)) > "$COUNTER_FILE"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/bin/shuf
export PATH="/tmp/bin:$PATH"
/usr/local/bin/run_evaluation.sh /app/data/student_submissions /app/data/grading_rubric.txt 70
